root_cause: Tenant AI profiles could select Google Vertex, but the trusted inference gateway rejected it because no region-pinned adapter existed. Selecting a model alone must never activate inference.
prevention: Require independently signed tenant/provider/model/region/expiry proof plus customer consent and cleared cross-domain review including CSRD scope
Use only allowlisted fixed Google Vertex regional hosts constructed from trusted server configuration; global, arbitrary and cross-region endpoints fail closed
Require trusted server Google project ID, OAuth bearer access token and provider readback/egress evidence before transmission
Require explicit Gemini publisher-model identifier and reject unsupported tool or safety responses without silent model/provider fallback
Keep real credentials and authorized live provider tests separate from repository fixture tests

evidence.outcome: Provider adapter and deny-before-egress tests; no customer Vertex account, tokens or live region readback provisioned
